review.notes: Extracted text of all 32 physical pages compared against the OCR markdown with a normalized line-presence scan (case/punctuation-insensitive); only footnote droppage was found. Page-bottom strips of pages 1, 6, 7 and 21 were rendered and visually verified. No code fences. Reference entries (pages 21-24 and 26-32), headings and equation text survived; the two scanner flags on pages 6 and 10 were false positives from LaTeX transcription of math lines. Inline-math punctuation spacing is handled by the shared normalizer.
